entries.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
entries.answer: Success means late signals resolve to existing source and closure records with occurrence/receipt timing and materiality; human reopen decisions preserve closure history; later observations classify closure alignment with uncertainty routed to governance; full QIF/AOF tests pass; exact commit releases as v0.8.11.
entries.expectation_state: runtime captured first-round clarification answers and can proceed to need validation

entries.question: need validation で何が確定したか
entries.answer: Validated after rejecting calibration-report duplication. The smallest coherent slice stays beside PortableKnowledgeIncidentClosure, distinguishes occurrence and receipt time, requires source/materiality evidence and human authority, and routes uncertain calibration to governance.

entries.question: framework self-audit で次に残る gap は何か
entries.answer: Closure policy revision and counterfactual replay remain outside this release and are the next value slice.
entries.expectation_state: Late signal, accountable reopen decision, and closure calibration are implemented in qif-ledger with immutable lineage, governance routing, retained negative fixtures, portable output, and explicit verifier boundaries.
entries.mismatch_state: Closure policy revision and counterfactual replay remain outside this release and are the next value slice.
entries.scale_direction: Deliver v0.8.12 closure policy revision and counterfactual replay without mutating historical decisions.
